propositions: rebar comment silently accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as positional body arguments, storing the literal flag string instead of the intended content while exiting with code 0
positional-body commands discard surplus arguments via args[:min_args] slice, compounding data loss when a flag token is stored as body
a user reaching for --body-file or --body option finds no such option exists, causing two independent sessions to lose critical attestation records
the -- escape hatch enables legitimate negative-starting body values while rejecting flag-like arguments with error messaging
the same footgun affects multiple positional-only commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) and requires consistent guards
